name: Marketing Pack
description: A small, ready-to-post marketing campaign for a product, offer or event: a one-page campaign brief, a two-week content calendar, and the post copy itself. The mission carries what is being promoted and to whom.
principles: Every post ties back to one campaign goal and one audience.
Speak to the customer's problem, not the product's features.
One clear call to action per post.
Keep one consistent voice across the whole campaign.

stages.name: Plan the campaign
stages.description: Decide the goal, audience, message and offer.

quality_gate.description: The brief names a goal, an audience, a single core message and a call to action.

deliverables.name: Campaign Brief
deliverables.description: The one-page plan the campaign runs from.

activities.name: Define the campaign
activities.description: Set the goal, the audience, the single core message, the offer, and the call to action. Keep it to one page a busy owner can act on.

stages.name: Create the content
stages.description: Turn the brief into a schedule and the posts themselves.

quality_gate.description: A dated schedule and ready-to-post copy both exist.

deliverables.name: Social Content Calendar
deliverables.description: A two-week posting schedule tied to the campaign.

activities.name: Plan the calendar
activities.description: Lay out a two-week posting schedule: for each post give the date, channel, theme and the hook, all serving the campaign goal.

deliverables.name: Social Post Drafts
deliverables.description: Ready-to-post copy for every scheduled post.

activities.name: Write the posts
activities.description: Write the full copy for each post in the calendar: the hook, the body, one clear call to action, and a few suggested hashtags. Keep to the campaign's voice.
